primary.arrival_process: Poisson intensity with predeclared shared shocks
primary.budget_regime_selection: uniform prior mixture fixed before final; not selected from final realized opportunities
primary.price_base: positive lognormal, median one synthetic cost unit; parameter ranges fixed in development contract
primary.purchase_value_unit: same synthetic cost units, independent value generator; no real currency claim

implementation_note: No Python loop over every event for GPU workloads. Vectorize within campaign/interval while preserving exact sequential budget settlement. Clock/ledger behavior must agree with a small CPU reference.
